title: Neoadjuvant Complete Response Customized Treatment Approach for Definitive Management of Breast Cancer
official: Neoadjuvant Complete Response Customized Treatment Approach for Definitive Management of Breast Cancer
summary: This study will evaluate the efficacy and non-inferiority of a non-surgical approach for the treatment of patients with locally advanced breast cancer.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. Provision of signed and dated informed consent form
2. Stated willingness to comply with all study procedures and availability for the duration of the study
3. Male or female, aged 18 years or older
4. Early-stage breast cancer diagnosis (cT1-3 N0 or cT1-2 N1) and a Human Epidermal Receptor 2 (HER2)-positive or triple negative breast cancer (TNBC) tumor molecular subtype
5. Cannot have extensive calcifications in the breast (for complex cases, a patient with calcification's eligibility will be discussed by the study co-principal investigators (PIs) and the treating physicians)
6. Planning to receive neoadjuvant chemotherapy (NAC) and radiation therapy (RT)

Exclusion Criteria:

1. Pregnancy or lactation
2. Inmate or prisoner
3. Treatment with an investigational drug or other intervention throughout their breast cancer treatment
4. Patients with skin involvement and/or distant metastases
